versions.changelog:
Initial release: Extracts trending YouTube videos by category and country.

- Fetch trending videos with support for categories (now, music, movies, gaming) and country/language codes.
- Returns detailed video data: title, URL, view/like count, channel info, description, and thumbnails.
- Supports limiting results and custom JavaScript mapping of outputs.
- Offers usage via Node.js script or REST API (Apify).
- Handles edge cases such as missing categories or empty results.
